title: A Cloud by Day, a Fire by Night
paragraphs: The people were free, but the desert was wide and frightening. How would they find the way? God gave them a sign: a tall cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night, moving ahead of them. When it moved, they moved. When it rested, they rested. And when they built a special tent to worship in, the glory of God filled it, and the cloud settled over it. God was not far off; God lived among them, travelling with them in their tents. Hold on to that picture, because it is exactly what will happen at Bethlehem: God, camped among us.
wonder: I wonder what it's like to have God so close you can see the cloud?
prayer: God who travels with us, guide our steps and stay close when we're afraid. Amen.
alt: A row of tents in the desert beneath a tall cloud lit with a golden thread that guides the way.
translation: Retold in our own words, following the World English Bible.
